It follows the **direct-deposit protocol adopted 2026-07-17**: the Render substrate at gravitywell-1.onrender.com was suspended, so tethers mint as Alexanarch deposits and cross-link to their predecessors rather than passing through the MCP surface.

This tether is where the chain later **forked**. Two successors conditioned on 👂🌰🔌 — one branch running #1116 → #1220 → #1405, another minted at #1431 from a stale ratchet — and the division stood because a `superseded_by` field holds a single successor and cannot express a fork. The braid at **#1433** healed it by citing #1405 as the recovered strand. The tether also carries a recorded erratum: its canonical bytes say "five of eleven" where four had landed; the bytes stand under non-destruction and the correction is inscribed beside them.
